title: Jardiiji ɓuuɓɗi ɗi ɓamtaare
intro: E nder leydi barkinndi e jawdi keewndi, renndo ina ƴellitoo, ina wuuri e nder maale moƴƴere Alla. Jaambaraagal maɓɓe ko seedantaagal moƴƴere Joomiraawo maɓɓe, dokkal ngal ɓe njiɗi ko ustude yettoode e ɗooftaare. Kono, hay so tawii barkeeji maɓɓe ina laaɓti, mbayliigu arii, luulndii weltaare maɓɓe e iwdi ngalu maɓɓe keewngu e wellitaare maɓɓe.
clues: En keɓii barkeeji ɗiɗi, gooto e bannge ñaamo, gooto e bannge nano, keewɗi geɗe.
En njamiraama ñaamde e riiski Joomiraawo men, en njettu ɗum leydi moƴƴiri e Joomiraawo yaafotooɗo.
En mawnii, en njippiima e laawol yettoode, en mbeltiima e jawdi men e doole men.
Min ɗaɓɓiri Joomiraawo amen ɓeydude woɗɗude hakkunde yahdu amen, hollirde majjere e weeyo ngo o rokki.
Min njeertinaama e nulaaɗo, kono min njaɓaani nelal ngal, min njokki e majjere amen.
Baraas men mawɗo, joginooɗo ngalu men, haa jooni, yani, waɗi ilam bonɗam.

Min ndarii, leydi amen wonti ɓulli

outcome.answer: Min ndarii, leydi amen wonti ɓulli

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
